candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans
verified_facts: Official HM Land Registry routing page links the current plan practice guides, including PG40 supplements and PG41 surveying guidance.
The page applies to England and Wales.
semantic_limits: Guide routing is authority/freshness evidence only; it is not parcel geometry or terrain measurement evidence.

candidates.name: Practice guide 40: guide overview of Land Registry plans
verified_facts: The official guide overview separates the basis of HM Land Registry plans, plan preparation, boundaries, determined boundaries and title-plan guidance into distinct supplements.
It identifies Supplement 1 as the mapping-basis reference and Supplement 2 as the application-plan preparation reference.
semantic_limits: The guide framework must not be used as numeric height evidence.

candidates.name: PG40 supplement 1 — basis of HM Land Registry plans
verified_facts: HM Land Registry states Ordnance Survey mapping shows topographic features and is not intended to represent property boundaries.
The guide explains common mapping scales and that mapped feature positions have specified accuracy tolerances rather than exact ground positions.
semantic_limits: Plan/mapping accuracy is horizontal planimetric evidence and must not be converted to LiDAR vertical RMSE.

candidates.name: PG41 supplement 5 — plan requirements and surveying specification
verified_facts: The official specification requires lodged plans to show scale and orientation and identifies 1:500 as preferred for estate layouts, with 1:1250 potentially acceptable where detail is clear.
Plans marked only for identification or not to scale are not acceptable for that workflow.
semantic_limits: Application-plan scale requirements do not establish terrain height accuracy or LiDAR lineage.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 contour data
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 contour data use GML 3.2.1 simple features level 0 and include per-tile metadata.
Spot heights are selected by an automated process and z values are rounded to one decimal place.
semantic_limits: Contour/spot-height encoding is secondary evidence and must not replace the EA 1m DTM primary sample.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 GML feature types
verified_facts: The GML feature model distinguishes contour lines, spot heights and land/water boundaries.
Spot-height property values are heights above Newlyn or another British height datum.
semantic_limits: Feature-type attributes and datum declarations are not parcel-specific EA survey lineage.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Esri shapefile
verified_facts: The Terrain 5 shapefile supply separates line and point feature components and includes projection and metadata files.
Per-tile metadata accompanies contour data and can include flying-date information.
semantic_limits: File packaging and projection metadata are lineage support only, not primary numeric terrain evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 product glossary
verified_facts: Ordnance Survey explicitly distinguishes resolution from accuracy and notes high resolution does not imply high accuracy.
The glossary defines rectangular coordinates as eastings/northings on a projected plane.
semantic_limits: A 5m or 1m resolution label must never be promoted to an equivalent accuracy claim.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 downloads
verified_facts: The official downloads page routes users to OS Data Hub for product downloads and provides XML schema resources for contour and gridded products.
Schema resources support format validation but are separate from terrain observations.
semantic_limits: Schema availability validates structure, not parcel height values or acquisition lineage.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Esri shapefile
verified_facts: Terrain 50 shapefile contour supply separates point and line features and includes projection and per-tile metadata files.
The metadata file provides contour-tile information such as flying date.
semantic_limits: Terrain 50 remains a coarse secondary cross-check and cannot replace EA DTM1m.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 GML feature types
verified_facts: Terrain 50 GML includes spot-height values above Newlyn or another British height datum.
OS Terrain feature identifiers are unique within a release and regenerated on whole-tile refresh; the CRS is EPSG:27700 British National Grid.
semantic_limits: Release identifiers and datum fields do not establish EA composite survey identity.

candidates.name: OGC Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set and Tile Set Metadata 2.0
verified_facts: The approved OGC standard defines tile matrix sets and tile-set metadata with XML and JSON encodings.
Tile matrix sets partition and index space using regular grids in a coordinate reference system.
semantic_limits: Tile indexing geometry and scale are delivery/discovery semantics, not proof of native terrain sampling or vertical accuracy.
